summary: Addentax Group Corp. (ATXG) on Form 8-K reports completion of its acquisition of 100% of Time Is Loan Limited (Target) via its Hong Kong subsidiary Yingxi Industrial Chain Investment Co., Ltd., effective May 15, 2026. Consideration was 137,790 shares of ATXG common stock (par value $0.001) issued to seller Ms. OR Shan Shan. No cash price per share or valuation is disclosed; shares were issued offshore under Regulation S exemption. Board recommendation/advisor is not named. The transaction closed about three weeks after the April 22 Share Exchange Agreement. What to watch: lack of disclosed valuation and financial targets may raise questions about accretion; no post-closing earnout or lock-up terms noted.
